data.long_meaning: Sullan is a Hindi name that is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Suryalana' which means 'Lord of the Sun'. This name is believed to bestow the strength and power of the Sun upon the bearer. The name Sullan carries the meaning “Lord of the Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sullan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sullan is a powerful name that is rooted in the spiritual traditions of Hinduism. It represents the divine energy of the Sun and is believed to bring strength, courage, and vitality to those who bear it.
data.etymology: Sullan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sullan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

It is often given to boys at birth to bless them with strength, vitality, and good health, as the Sun is believed to be the source of all life-giving energy.

It is believed that those who carry this name are blessed with the qualities of truth, integrity, and courage, which are essential for leading a virtuous and fulfilling life. Additionally, the name Sullan reminds us of the importance of harnessing the power of the Sun within ourselves to overcome the challenges of life and achieve success and happiness.

historical_references.reference: Sullan was a prominent general of the Hindu-Malay kingdom of Kedah in the late 15th century. He is best known for his successful defense against the invasion by the Portuguese under Afonso de Albuquerque in 1498.

Sullan also played a significant role in the political history of the Malay Peninsula during the 15th century. He was a vassal ruler of the powerful Hindu-Malay kingdom of Manjapahit, and led a rebellion against its king, Parameswara, in 1467.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Sullan' originated from the Tamil word 'sollan' meaning 'king' or 'emperor'. It has gained modern usage in various contexts, particularly in Malayalam cinema where it is used as a title for powerful characters, such as in the films 'Sullan' (2016) and 'The Great Sullivan' (2017). In Tamil Nadu politics, the name Sullan has been used as a title for political leaders, including the famous Periyar E.V. Ramaswamy, who was popularly known as 'Sullan Periyar'. In historical fiction, 'Sullan: The King's Man' is a popular novel by R.S. Subrahmaniyam that explores the life and times of a powerful Hindu king named Sullan. The name continues to be seen on these three platforms as a symbol of power, authority, and leadership.
